name: read-guard
body: Every agent (including the navigator/coordinator) denies `read`/`glob`/`grep` on graph-state paths (`apg/.trans/**`, `apg/layers/**`, and worktree mirrors `apg/.worktrees/*/apg/.trans/**`, `apg/.worktrees/*/apg/layers/**`) and drops the bash file-read commands (`cat *`, `head *`, `tail *`, `dd *`, `rg *`, `grep *`) so bash cannot reach those files. `apg/**` is NOT blocked wholesale: `apg/.worktrees/**` stays readable/editable and `apg/config.json` stays readable.
